01

Get the basics right

Deadlifts, step-ups, Bulgarian split squats, glute bridges and calf raises can support your rucking training.

  • Squat or split-squat for controlled leg work.
  • Hinge and carry to build strength for load handling.
  • Use calf raises, step-ups and balance work for uneven terrain.
02

Match the work to the goal

Strength sessions can support your rucks, but they are not a substitute for time on your feet.

  • Choose a few movements and repeat them consistently.
  • Use manageable technique and progress over time.
  • Back off when fatigue affects movement quality.
